onboarding.step1.body: Your clipboard, reimagined. SNIPLY remembers what you copy and automatically recognizes HEX/RGB colors, JSON payloads, URLs, code snippets, and high-resolution images.
onboarding.step1.title: Welcome to SNIPLY
onboarding.step2.body: Everything you copy is stored strictly on your device inside a local SQLite database. There are no accounts, no cloud servers, no telemetry, and zero external network requests.
onboarding.step2.title: 100% Local & Private History
onboarding.step3.body: Press Ctrl + Shift + V from any application to summon the compact Quick Paste bar. Search thousands of clips in milliseconds and press Enter to restore.
onboarding.step3.title: Instant Quick Paste Anywhere
onboarding.step4.body: Password managers (1Password, KeePassXC, Bitwarden) are excluded by default, and conservative secret filtering skips obvious API keys and private keys.
onboarding.step4.title: Smart Privacy & App Exclusions
onboarding.step5.body: SNIPLY never collects clipboard history without your explicit permission. Choose how you want monitoring and retention configured:
onboarding.step5.consent_checkbox: I understand and enable local clipboard monitoring
onboarding.step5.title: Consent & Monitoring Preferences
onboarding.step6.body: SNIPLY is ready. You can pause monitoring anytime from the system tray or explore the optional Demo Gallery to see smart recognition in action.
onboarding.step6.title: You're All Set
